1. State three qualities of composite materials that make them suitable for use in the
 manufacture of sports equipment. (3 marks)
2. The following are properties of ceramic materials:
 i. Brittleness
 ii. Hardness
 iii. Resistance to wear
 iv. Electrical insulation
 v. Thermal insulation
 vi. Thermal shock
 Identify three properties that make ceramic materials suitable for making floor tiles.
 (3 marks)
3. Grade 8 learners were using a steel rule to measure the length of wood for a project.
 Draw part of the steel rule to show a reading of 24.4 cm. (2 marks)
4. A farmer intends to trim the hedge of flowers around the farm. The farmer has the
 following hand tools in the store:
 i. Rake
 ii. Hammer
 iii. Shear
 iv. Hoe
 v. Sickle
 vi. Slasher
 Identify two hand tools that the farmer will use to trim the hedge. (2 marks)
Pre-technical Studies
School Based Assessment

5. During a practical lesson, a Grade 8 teacher brought tools shown in the table below.
 Complete the table by giving the name and use of each tool. (6 marks)
 Diagram Name of tool Use of tool
6. A group of Grade 8 learners discussed about the fire fighting technique that involves
 cutting off oxygen supply to the fire.
 a) Identify the fire fighting technique discussed by the learners. (1 mark)
 b) Name two methods that can be used to carry out the fire fighting technique in (a).
 (2 marks)
7. A pre-technical teacher in Grade 8, gave learners a task to make a stool whose top is
 square in shape. The length of the square shape is 4.5 cm. Use instruments to draw
 the square and dimension it. (4 marks)

8. An entrepreneur intends to start a business. Identify two sources of income the
 entrepreneur may use to finance the business. (2 marks)
9. Mr.Tayari started a juice production business and wants to gather information about
 potential customers. Which three sources can he use to get this information?
 (3 marks)
10. Pendo owns a bakery producing a variety of products that are purchased by Mwalimu
 wholesalers for distribution and selling. State three benefits of Mwalimu wholesalers
 as an intermediary to Pendo. (3 marks)
11. The following information relates to Mwenda Pesi Traders as at 31st December 2023.
 Ksh
 Machinery 105,000
 Creditors 72,000
 Building 300,000
 Bank loan 150,000
 Debtors 23,000
 a) Calculate the capital of Mwenda Pesi Traders. (3 marks)
Pre-technical Studies
School Based Assessment
Grade 8 © 2024 The Kenya National Examinations Council
 b) Prepare Mwenda Pesi Traders statement of financial position as at 31st December
 2023. (4 marks)
12. Peter created some instructions using a visual programming application.
 a) Name two types of visual programming applications that he could have used.
 (2 marks)
 b) State the feature that he would use to perform each of the following tasks:
 i. Changing the costume of the sprite. (1 mark)
 ii. Making the Sprite move on the stage. (1 mark)
13. Baraka’s laptop was infected by a computer virus and lost some of the data got stored.
 a) Explain one way he should protect the data from getting lost as a result of virus
 infection. (2 marks)
 b) State one benefit of storing data in an electronic device. (1 mark)
Pre-technical Studies
School Based Assessment

14. A Junior School uses the following computer software to perform tasks.
 System software, spreadsheets, word processing, communication software
 Identify the suitable software from the list given above that the school uses for the
 following tasks: (3 marks)
 a) Preparing the school budget ____________________________________________
 b) Typing lesson notes for teachers ________________________________________
 c) Sending electronic mails to teachers ______________________
15. A learner would like to view slides created in a presentation software. Name two types
 of views that the learner may use. (2 marks)
